products.name: Lithium Iron Phosphate (LiFePO4) Batteries
products.description: High-performance lithium iron phosphate batteries designed, assembled, and manufactured for use in recreational vehicles (RVs), marine vessels, industrial equipment, construction, surveillance, remote monitoring, and specialty vehicle applications. These batteries are engineered in-house, incorporate proprietary safety and performance features, and are produced using third-party manufacturing partners.

products.name: Battery Accessories and Components
products.description: A suite of supporting accessories and components for lithium battery installations or conversions, including chargers, monitors, inverters, and solar components sourced from third-party brands. These are sold to complement the company's battery offerings for new installations or conversions.

products.name: Industrial Energy Storage Systems
products.description: Integrated energy storage systems for industrial applications, such as the DASGen Hybrid Energy Storage System, which function as energy buffers between diesel generators and jobsite electrical loads. These systems utilize the company's lithium battery technology and are assembled in partnership with third parties.

products.name: Home Energy Storage Solutions
products.description: Lithium-based home energy storage solutions designed to provide backup or off-grid power for residential applications. These systems leverage the company's battery technology and are engineered for safety and reliability.

products.name: Battery Management and Monitoring Software (e360 SmartTalk)
products.description: Proprietary mobile application and embedded software for wireless monitoring and management of Bluetooth-enabled lithium batteries, providing users with real-time data on battery conditions and performance. Delivered digitally and integrated into many battery models.

products.name: Physician-Enablement Platform (Privia Platform)
products.description: A comprehensive, cloud-based technology and service platform that integrates Privia-developed and third-party applications to manage all aspects of healthcare service provision for physician practices, including data analytics, revenue cycle management, practice and clinical operations, and payer alignment. Delivered digitally and through in-person support, it enables both virtual and in-person care settings.

products.name: Practice Management and Administrative Services
products.description: Management and administrative services provided to physician practices and medical groups, including revenue cycle management, business operations consulting, procurement, analytics, and payer contracting. Delivered through local management services organizations (MSOs) and supported by technology and in-person consulting.

products.name: Value-Based Care (VBC) Programs and Population Health Management
products.description: Programs and services that enable providers to participate in value-based care arrangements, including accountable care organizations (ACOs), care management, population health analytics, and risk-based contracting with payers and employers. Delivered through technology, analytics, and coordinated provider networks.

products.name: Direct Patient Care Services (Primary and Specialty Care)
products.description: Healthcare services delivered directly to patients by Privia Providers through both in-person and virtual visits, including primary care and specialty care across a broad range of demographics and payer types. Delivered at over 1,300 practice locations and via telehealth.

products.name: Virtual Care Services (Telehealth and Digital Health)
products.description: Virtual healthcare services including on-demand virtual visits, telehealth consultations, virtual scribes, and remote patient monitoring, fully integrated with electronic medical records and accessible via mobile app and patient portal. Delivered digitally to patients and providers.

products.name: Employer Health Solutions (Direct Primary Care and Custom Benefits)
products.description: Customized medical benefits packages and direct primary care services offered to employers, including onsite/near-site clinics and population health solutions, supported by Privia’s provider networks and technology platform. Delivered through partnerships with employers and integration with local provider networks.

products.name: Ancillary Healthcare Services (Laboratory, Imaging, Pharmacy)
products.description: Ancillary services such as clinical laboratory, imaging, and pharmacy provided within Privia Medical Groups, leveraging existing provider and patient platforms. Delivered through in-office or affiliated service providers.

products.name: Clinical Research Services
products.description: Design and execution of clinical trials across multiple therapeutic areas, offered to patients and providers within the Privia network. Delivered through partnerships and integration with provider practices.

products.name: Behavioral Health Management Services
products.description: Behavioral health management services offered to Privia Providers, patients, or employers, including virtual mental healthcare and care coordination. Delivered through digital and in-person channels.

products.name: Maritime Domain Awareness Solutions (MDAS)
products.description: Integrated surveillance and monitoring systems for persistent, real-time ocean monitoring, combining proprietary hardware (PowerBuoy®, WAM-V®) and software (Merrows™) with multi-modal sensors and cloud-based analytics. Delivered as a customizable, scalable solution for defense, security, infrastructure, and environmental applications.

products.name: Data as a Service (DaaS)
products.description: Subscription-based service providing persistent, near real-time collection and transmission of maritime and environmental intelligence data using autonomous vehicles and sensor-equipped platforms. Includes deployment, operation, and data delivery for security, regulatory, and commercial needs.

products.name: Robotics as a Service (RaaS)
products.description: Subscription-based access to WAM-V® autonomous surface vehicles, including leasing, operational support, maintenance, and training. Enables customers to utilize autonomous maritime robotics for surveying, security, and inspection without capital purchase.

products.name: Power as a Service (PaaS)
products.description: Subscription-based access to PowerBuoy® autonomous offshore power platforms, providing renewable energy for remote maritime operations. Includes deployment, maintenance, and flexible leasing for defense, energy, and environmental monitoring applications.

products.name: Autonomous Surface Vehicles (WAM-V®)
products.description: Manufacture and sale (or lease) of modular, autonomous unmanned surface vessels (USVs) designed for data acquisition, surveying, security, and research in marine environments. Platforms are customizable for various payloads and missions, and are delivered globally.

products.name: Autonomous Offshore Power Platforms (PowerBuoy®)
products.description: Manufacture and sale (or lease) of PowerBuoy® platforms that generate renewable energy from wave, solar, and wind sources, providing continuous power and data connectivity for remote maritime operations. Supports a range of payloads and is used in security, monitoring, and research.

products.name: Sure Shot Dietary Supplement
products.description: An over-the-counter liquid and powdered dietary supplement designed to lower blood alcohol content by supporting alcohol metabolism, manufactured by contract manufacturers and distributed through e-commerce and retail channels.

products.name: Plant-Based Energy Beverages
products.description: A line of clean, plant-based energy drinks (acquired via Yerbaé Brands) produced by contract manufacturers and distributed through retail and e-commerce channels.

products.name: Digital Asset Revenue Participation
products.description: Participation in revenue streams and commercialization opportunities related to the Bonk digital platform and other blockchain-based initiatives, including holding and monetizing Bonk tokens and revenue sharing from digital platforms.

products.name: Zeta Marketing Platform (ZMP)
products.description: An AI-powered, cloud-based marketing automation platform that enables enterprises to acquire, grow, and retain consumer relationships through personalized, omnichannel marketing. Delivered as a SaaS solution, it integrates data management, analytics, and campaign execution across digital channels.

products.name: Email Service Provider (ESP) – Zeta Messaging
products.description: A comprehensive, AI-powered messaging solution that automates and optimizes personalized campaigns across email, mobile, social, and other digital channels. Delivered via the ZMP, it includes segmentation, content optimization, and omnichannel orchestration.

products.name: Customer Data Platform (CDP+)
products.description: A cloud-based data management solution that consolidates, organizes, and activates consumer data from multiple sources, enabling real-time identity resolution and personalized engagement across channels. Delivered as a module within the ZMP.

products.name: Demand Side Platform (DSP)
products.description: An AI-driven media buying platform that enables enterprises to execute, optimize, and attribute paid media campaigns across desktop, mobile, CTV, social, and other digital channels. Integrated within the ZMP, it leverages proprietary identity graphs and real-time optimization.

products.name: Zeta Answers Intelligence Suite
products.description: A suite of AI-powered analytics and intelligence tools that synthesize behavioral and intent data to provide actionable insights for marketing strategy, customer acquisition, retention, and competitive analysis. Delivered as modules within the ZMP, available via licensing or usage fees.

products.name: Athena by Zeta
products.description: An AI-native orchestration and automation interface that enables natural-language and voice-enabled interaction with the ZMP, routing requests to relevant AI models and applications to personalize user experiences and accelerate marketing execution. Delivered as an interface layer within the ZMP.

products.name: Data Licensing and Enrichment Services
products.description: Provision of proprietary, partner, and public consumer data sets, including demographic, behavioral, and intent data, for use in marketing programs and analytics. Delivered via the ZMP and available for integration with customer systems.

products.name: Consulting and Integration Services
products.description: Professional services including technical upgrades, custom integrations, and strategic consulting to support deployment and optimization of the ZMP and its modules. Delivered by in-house experts as an add-on to platform subscriptions.

products.name: AUVELITY
products.description: An FDA-approved, proprietary oral medication for major depressive disorder (MDD) in adults, combining dextromethorphan and bupropion, manufactured using proprietary formulation and metabolic inhibition technology. Delivered as a prescription pharmaceutical product.

products.name: SUNOSI
products.description: A novel, oral prescription medication (solriamfetol) for excessive daytime sleepiness (EDS) associated with obstructive sleep apnea or narcolepsy, manufactured as a small molecule drug and distributed in the U.S. and Europe. Delivered as a prescription pharmaceutical product.

products.name: SYMBRAVO
products.description: A novel, oral, rapidly absorbed medication (MoSEICTM meloxicam-rizatriptan) for the acute treatment of migraine in adults, utilizing proprietary formulation technology for enhanced absorption. Delivered as a prescription pharmaceutical product.

products.name: AXS-05 (Pipeline Indications)
products.description: An investigational oral medication (dextromethorphan-bupropion) being developed for additional CNS indications beyond MDD, including Alzheimer’s disease agitation and smoking cessation, using proprietary formulation and metabolic inhibition technology. Delivered as a prescription pharmaceutical product upon approval.

products.name: Solriamfetol (Pipeline Indications)
products.description: An investigational oral medication (solriamfetol) being developed for additional CNS indications beyond EDS, including ADHD, MDD with EDS symptoms, binge eating disorder, and shift work disorder. Delivered as a prescription pharmaceutical product upon approval.

products.name: AXS-12 (Reboxetine)
products.description: A novel, oral investigational norepinephrine reuptake inhibitor (NRI) being developed for the treatment of narcolepsy, manufactured as a small molecule drug. Delivered as a prescription pharmaceutical product upon approval.

products.name: AXS-14 (Esreboxetine)
products.description: A novel, oral investigational NRI being developed for the management of fibromyalgia, manufactured as a small molecule drug. Delivered as a prescription pharmaceutical product upon approval.

products.name: AXS-17
products.description: A novel, oral GABAA α2,3 receptor positive allosteric modulator being developed for the treatment of epilepsy, manufactured as a small molecule drug. Delivered as a prescription pharmaceutical product upon approval.

products.name: ON24 Intelligent Engagement Platform
products.description: A cloud-based platform that enables businesses to create, manage, and deliver interactive, personalized digital experiences for B2B sales and marketing, including webinars, virtual events, and multimedia content hubs. Delivered as a SaaS solution, it integrates AI-powered analytics, content creation, and third-party business system integrations.

products.name: Interactive Webinar Experiences (ON24 Elite)
products.description: A customizable, live and on-demand webinar product that allows businesses to engage large audiences with interactive features such as Q&A, polls, chat, and multimedia presentations. Delivered digitally via web browsers, it supports real-time and pre-recorded formats with AI-driven personalization and analytics.

products.name: Virtual Event Experiences (ON24 Go Live, ON24 Forums, ON24 Breakouts)
products.description: A suite of live, interactive video event products enabling businesses to host virtual conferences, networking sessions, breakout rooms, and moderated discussions for audience engagement and collaboration. Delivered digitally, these products support multi-session events, face-to-face networking, and audience participation at scale.

products.name: Multimedia Content Hubs (ON24 Engagement Hub)
products.description: An always-on, online resource portal that allows businesses to curate, publish, and promote interactive webinars and multimedia marketing content (videos, whitepapers) in a single destination for prospective customers. Delivered as a web-based platform with AI-driven personalization and analytics.

products.name: Personalized Content Experiences (ON24 Target)
products.description: A digital marketing product that enables businesses to build and disseminate personalized, interactive landing pages and multimedia experiences tailored to specific customer segments. Delivered via the cloud, it leverages AI for content and call-to-action personalization.

products.name: Analytics and Insights Solutions (ON24 Intelligence, ON24 Advanced Analytics)
products.description: A suite of analytics products providing real-time, first-person data, benchmarking, reporting, and engagement scoring for digital experiences. Delivered as part of the platform, these tools use AI and proprietary algorithms to generate actionable insights for sales and marketing optimization.

products.name: AI-Powered Content Creation and Personalization (ON24 AI-powered ACE)
products.description: An AI-driven solution embedded in the platform that automates the creation of written and video content, delivers personalized content recommendations, and provides advanced analytics for digital experiences. Utilizes generative AI, NLP, and machine learning to enhance engagement and efficiency.

products.name: Third-Party Integrations and APIs (ON24 Connect)
products.description: A set of integrations and APIs that allow customers to connect ON24 platform data and experiences with external business systems such as marketing automation, CRM, and BI platforms. Delivered as cloud-based connectors and developer APIs.

products.name: Professional Services and Platform Support
products.description: A portfolio of consulting, training, and technical support services to assist customers with product adoption, experience management, and platform optimization. Delivered by in-house teams as part of customer onboarding and ongoing support.

products.name: Virtual Conference Solution (ON24 Virtual Conference)
products.description: A managed-service product for hosting large-scale, multi-session virtual conferences and trade shows, simulating in-person events with interactive webinars, networking, and analytics. Delivered digitally, but currently deemphasized due to reduced demand.

products.name: Media & Advertising Services
products.description: Comprehensive services including strategic media planning, buying and optimization, data and analytics, creative advertising, and content production, delivered through a global network of agencies using integrated technology platforms and creative teams.

products.name: Precision Marketing Services
products.description: Technology-driven marketing solutions such as digital transformation consulting, decision sciences, digital experience design, customer relationship management, and e-commerce and enterprise platforms, leveraging data, analytics, and digital tools to optimize client marketing strategies.

products.name: Public Relations and Corporate Communications
products.description: Services including corporate communications, crisis management, public affairs, media relations, investor relations, and organizational communications, provided by specialized agencies to manage and enhance client reputations and stakeholder engagement.

products.name: Healthcare Marketing and Communications
products.description: Specialized marketing, advertising, and communications services for healthcare and pharmaceutical companies, including corporate communications, media services, and healthcare-specific campaigns, delivered by dedicated healthcare agencies.

products.name: Branding and Retail Commerce Services
products.description: Brand and product consulting, strategy and research, retail marketing, package design, and retail commerce solutions, supporting clients in building and managing brands and driving retail sales through both physical and digital channels.

products.name: Experiential and Event Marketing
products.description: Design and execution of live and digital events, experiential marketing campaigns, sports and entertainment marketing, and experience design, aimed at engaging consumers through immersive brand experiences.

products.name: Execution and Support Services
products.description: Field marketing, sales support, merchandising (digital and physical), point-of-sale, product placement, and other specialized marketing execution services, supporting clients in implementing marketing strategies at the ground level.

products.name: Data Analytics and Marketing Intelligence Platforms
products.description: Provision of proprietary marketing intelligence platforms (such as Omni), customer data analytics, identity and data management, and integration of AI-based tools to support and optimize marketing, media, and creative workflows for clients.

products.name: Cabinet Locks and Locking Mechanisms
products.description: Mechanical and electronic cabinet locks and other locking mechanisms manufactured primarily from zinc and brass, sold to industries such as postal, furniture, cabinetry, tool storage, healthcare, gas stations, and vending equipment. Products include disc tumbler locks, pin tumbler locks, and electronic locks, delivered through direct sales and distribution networks.

products.name: Marine Components
products.description: Manufacture and distribution of high-precision marine components such as wake enhancement systems, stainless steel exhaust systems, gauges, throttle controls, trim tabs, and related hardware and accessories, primarily for recreational boats and also for industrial markets. Products are produced using stainless steel, aluminum, and other metals at dedicated facilities.

products.name: Titanium Dioxide Pigments (TiO2)
products.description: Production and sale of value-added titanium dioxide pigments, manufactured using chloride and sulfate processes at facilities in North America and Europe. TiO2 is sold in dry or slurry form to customers in coatings, plastics, paper, inks, cosmetics, pharmaceuticals, and other industrial and consumer markets.

products.name: Ilmenite Ore
products.description: Mining and sale of ilmenite ore, a titanium-containing feedstock used in the sulfate process for TiO2 production. The ore is mined in Norway and sold both internally to Kronos’ sulfate plants and externally to third parties, including competitors.

products.name: Iron-Based Chemicals
products.description: Manufacture and sale of iron-based chemicals, which are co-products and processed co-products of TiO2 pigment production. These chemicals are marketed primarily as treatment and conditioning agents for industrial effluents and municipal wastewater, and in the manufacture of iron pigments, cement, and agricultural products.

products.name: Specialty Chemicals (Side-Stream Products)
products.description: Production and sale of specialty chemicals derived as side-stream products from TiO2 manufacturing. These are used in applications such as pearlescent pigments, electroceramic capacitors for electronics, and specialty applications including natural gas pipe.

products.name: Residential Mortgage Loans
products.description: Origination and servicing of fixed-rate and adjustable-rate first mortgage loans for the purchase or refinance of one- to four-family owner-occupied residential real estate, including both conforming and jumbo loans. Loans are originated through branch offices, loan production offices, direct mail, call center, and internet, and may be sold to third parties with servicing retained.

products.name: Home Equity Lines of Credit (HELOCs)
products.description: Origination of adjustable-rate home equity lines of credit, primarily secured by a second mortgage on primary residences, offered in 28 states and the District of Columbia. These lines allow customers to draw funds as needed, subject to credit and property conditions, and are delivered through branches, call center, and online channels.

products.name: Home Equity Loans and Bridge Loans
products.description: Origination of fixed- and variable-rate home equity loans and short-term bridge loans, primarily secured by a second mortgage on primary residences, with terms up to 30 years for home equity loans and one year for bridge loans. These are offered in multiple states and delivered through branches, call center, and online.

products.name: Residential Construction Loans
products.description: Origination of construction/permanent loans to individuals for the construction of their personal single-family residence by a qualified builder. These loans provide disbursements during construction and convert to permanent amortizing loans upon completion, with both fixed and adjustable rates available.

products.name: Retail Deposit Accounts
products.description: Offering of retail deposit products including checking accounts, savings accounts, money market accounts, and certificates of deposit (CDs), available through branch offices, call center, and internet. These accounts are interest-bearing and serve as the primary funding source for lending activities.

products.name: Loan Servicing for Third Parties
products.description: Servicing of residential mortgage loans sold to third parties, primarily Fannie Mae and others, including collecting payments, managing escrow accounts, and handling customer service. The company retains servicing rights on the majority of loans sold, generating fee income.

products.name: Escrow and Settlement Services
products.description: Provision of escrow and settlement services for real estate transactions through minority-owned title agency subsidiaries, primarily in Ohio, Florida, and New Jersey, serving customers of the Association.

products.name: Cloud Fax Solutions
products.description: Cloud-based fax services delivered via a scalable SaaS platform, enabling users to send, receive, and manage faxes digitally through web interfaces, APIs, or integration with enterprise applications. Includes offerings for both corporate and small office/home office (SoHo) customers, with specialized solutions for regulated industries and public sector.

products.name: Healthcare Interoperability Solutions
products.description: Digital platforms and tools that facilitate secure exchange, integration, and interoperability of healthcare information, including support for HL7, FHIR, Direct Secure Messaging, and EHR integration. Delivered as SaaS and designed to meet the needs of healthcare providers for digitization and compliance.

products.name: Intelligent Data Extraction and Transformation
products.description: AI-powered solutions that extract, comprehend, and transform unstructured documents (such as faxes and scans) into structured, actionable data, primarily for healthcare and regulated industries. Delivered via SaaS platforms using NLP and AI technologies.

products.name: Electronic Signature Solutions
products.description: Digital signature and document markup services provided via web applications and enterprise APIs, enabling secure electronic signing and workflow management for businesses and individuals. Delivered as a SaaS offering.

products.name: Interoperability and Integration Platforms
products.description: Enterprise-grade platforms and interface engines that enable seamless integration of data and connectivity across multiple standards (API/FHIR, HL7, Direct Secure Messaging, web services, message queues) for complex interoperability challenges in regulated industries.

products.name: Retirement Plan Solutions and Administration
products.description: Comprehensive retirement plan solutions for employers, including plan administration, recordkeeping, trustee services, and investment options across defined contribution plans (401(k), 403(b), 457), delivered via digital and in-person channels. Products are structured as annuity contracts, group funding agreements, collective investment trusts, or mutual funds, and require regulated infrastructure and financial capital.

products.name: Retail Wealth Management and Advisory Services
products.description: Investment and financial planning services for individuals, including IRA accounts, managed accounts, mutual funds, and brokerage accounts, delivered through registered investment advisors and broker-dealer representatives, both in-person and via phone. Requires licensed financial professionals and digital platforms.

products.name: Investment Management Services
products.description: Global asset management for institutional and retail clients, offering actively managed fixed income, equities, multi-asset, and alternative investment strategies, including private equity and private credit, delivered through proprietary investment teams and distributed via institutional and intermediary channels. Requires significant financial capital, research, and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Employee Benefits Insurance Products
products.description: Group insurance products for employers, including stop loss, group life, group disability, and voluntary supplemental health insurance (critical illness, accident, hospital indemnity, whole and term life), underwritten and administered for mid-sized to large employers. Requires regulated insurance infrastructure and underwriting expertise.

products.name: Benefits Administration Services
products.description: Benefits enrollment and administration services for employers and health plans, delivered via open-architecture, product-agnostic digital platforms (Benefitplace), including online and telephone enrollment, billing, and administration. Requires proprietary software platforms and integration with employer systems.

products.name: Health Account Solutions
products.description: Administration and custodial services for health savings accounts (HSA), flexible spending accounts (FSA), health reimbursement arrangements (HRA), commuter and dependent care benefits, and COBRA administration, delivered through digital platforms and supported by regulated trust entities.

products.name: Financial Wellness and Decision Support Tools
products.description: Digital tools and applications (such as MyVoyage) that provide employees with personalized financial guidance, decision support for benefits selection, and holistic financial wellness resources, delivered via desktop and mobile platforms. Requires proprietary software development and integration with benefits and retirement platforms.

products.name: Dog Toys & Accessories
products.description: Proprietary, in-house designed toys and accessories for dogs, including beds, leashes, apparel, and other accessories, delivered via subscription boxes (BarkBox, Super Chewer) or sold through retail and online partners. Products are physically manufactured, often sourced from China, and distributed through direct-to-consumer and retail channels.

products.name: Dog Treats & Chews
products.description: A range of dog treats and chews, including monthly-themed treats, sold both as part of subscription boxes and individually through direct-to-consumer and retail channels. Products are manufactured and distributed physically, with expansion into major retail stores and online marketplaces.

products.name: Dog Food (Kibble)
products.description: Premium-priced kibble for dogs, available for individual purchase or on an autoship basis, sold through direct-to-consumer and retail channels. Products are physically manufactured and distributed.

products.name: Dog Food Toppers
products.description: Meal-enhancing sprinkles, broths, and bites designed to be added to a dog’s meal to enhance flavor, often single-ingredient proteins. Sold through direct-to-consumer and retail channels, these are physically manufactured products.

products.name: Dog Supplements
products.description: A variety of dog supplements, such as hip and joint support and skin and coat support, targeted at specific breeds or health needs. Sold through direct-to-consumer and retail channels, these are physically manufactured products.

products.name: Dog Dental Products
products.description: Dental chews and toothpastes (BARK Bright) aimed at improving dog dental health, including innovative dental kits. Sold through direct-to-consumer and retail channels, these are physically manufactured products.

products.name: Dog Air Travel Services (BARK Air)
products.description: Premium air travel experiences tailored for dogs and their owners, operated in partnership with charter companies. BARK focuses on curating the travel experience, while partners provide aircraft and operations. Bookings are made online, and the service is delivered physically via flights.

products.name: Lithium Concentrate Production
products.description: Mining and processing of hard-rock lithium ore to produce lithium concentrate (spodumene concentrate), primarily using a modular dense media separation plant in Minas Gerais, Brazil. The product is delivered to the global battery supply chain for electric vehicles and energy storage systems.

products.name: Exploration and Development of Battery Mineral Properties
products.description: Exploration and development of mineral rights for battery minerals including lithium, nickel, copper, rare earths, graphite, and titanium, involving geological mapping, soil geochemistry, and drilling to quantify mineralization and prepare properties for potential future mining and production.

products.name: Commercial Banking Services
products.description: Comprehensive banking services for commercial and consumer customers, including deposit accounts, treasury management, commercial and industrial lending, commercial real estate lending, small business lending, consumer and home equity lending, private banking, merchant services, and title and land settlement services. Delivered through physical branches and technology-driven channels such as mobile banking and remote deposit capture.

products.name: Wealth Management and Advisory Services
products.description: Comprehensive wealth management and financial advisory services, including financial planning, retirement planning, and investment advisory, provided primarily through a registered investment advisory subsidiary. Services are delivered to professionals, high net worth individuals, companies, and bank customers, requiring licensed advisors and regulated infrastructure.

products.name: Mortgage Banking Services
products.description: Origination, processing, underwriting, closing, and post-closing of residential mortgage loans, including for-sale, portfolio, and wholesale mortgages, as well as home equity loans. Loans are originated for homeowners and small investors, with most sold in the secondary market and some servicing rights retained. Delivered through dedicated mortgage offices and consultants.

products.name: Equipment Leasing and Finance Services
products.description: Equipment leasing and other finance receivables provided to commercial customers through a specialized subsidiary. Involves underwriting, funding, and managing leases for business equipment, requiring financial capital and risk management.

products.name: Title Insurance and Land Settlement Services
products.description: Provision of title insurance and land settlement services for real estate transactions, delivered through a dedicated subsidiary. Involves regulated insurance products and in-person or remote settlement services for property buyers and sellers.

products.name: Pneumococcal Conjugate Vaccines (PCVs)
products.description: Broad-spectrum, carrier-sparing conjugate vaccines (VAX-31, VAX-24, VAX-XL) for the prevention of invasive pneumococcal disease (IPD) and pneumonia in adults and children, produced using proprietary cell-free protein synthesis and site-specific conjugation technology. Delivered as injectable vaccines, manufactured at scale via contract manufacturing organizations.

products.name: Group A Streptococcus (Group A Strep) Conjugate Vaccine
products.description: A novel conjugate vaccine candidate (VAX-A1) designed to prevent disease caused by Group A Streptococcus, using a conserved polysaccharide conjugated to a proprietary protein carrier, produced via cell-free protein synthesis and site-specific conjugation. Delivered as an injectable vaccine, currently in preclinical/early clinical development.

products.name: Shigella (Dysentery) Vaccine
products.description: A preclinical vaccine candidate (VAX-GI) for the prevention of dysentery and shigellosis caused by Shigella bacteria, utilizing cell-free produced IpaB antigen conjugated to Shigella polysaccharide, leveraging proprietary protein synthesis and conjugation technology. Delivered as an injectable vaccine, development currently paused beyond preclinical stage.

products.name: Apparel
products.description: Moderately-priced proprietary and national brand clothing for men, women, and children, sold through physical stores and online. Products are sourced from various suppliers and distributed via retail and e-commerce fulfillment centers.

products.name: Footwear
products.description: A range of proprietary and national brand shoes for all ages, available in stores and online, sourced from multiple vendors and distributed through retail and e-commerce channels.

products.name: Accessories
products.description: Proprietary and national brand accessories such as handbags, jewelry, and watches, sold in stores and online, distributed via retail and e-commerce fulfillment centers.

products.name: Beauty Products
products.description: A selection of beauty products including cosmetics and skincare from proprietary and national brands, available in stores and online, distributed through retail and e-commerce channels.

products.name: Home Products
products.description: A variety of home goods such as bedding, kitchenware, and decor from proprietary and national brands, sold in stores and online, distributed via retail and e-commerce fulfillment centers.

products.name: Property Management Staffing Services
products.description: Provision of on-demand, short-term, and direct hire field talent for maintenance and office roles to property management companies overseeing apartment communities and commercial buildings. Services are delivered through recruiting, screening, and assigning BGSF-employed field talent to client partner locations, with BGSF retaining employer responsibilities.

products.name: Residential Cabinetry
products.description: Manufacture and sale of cabinets for kitchens, bathrooms, and other parts of the home, spanning stock, semi-custom, and premium categories. Products are physically manufactured in company-owned facilities and distributed through dealers, retailers, builders, and e-commerce channels.

products.name: Indoor Golf Simulator Systems
products.description: Integrated hardware and software solutions for indoor golf simulation, including launch monitors, enclosures, turf, projectors, computers, and installation services. These systems are manufactured, assembled, and installed for residential, commercial, and custom applications.

products.name: Golf Launch Monitors
products.description: Proprietary hardware devices (e.g., APOGEE, LaunchBox) that measure and analyze golf shots for simulation and practice, designed for both portable and permanent indoor use, and bundled with software content.

products.name: Golf Simulation Software Platforms
products.description: Internally developed digital software platforms (E6 GOLF, E6 CONNECT) providing golf course simulation, practice tools, player development, online events, and compatibility with TruGolf and select third-party hardware. Delivered via licensing and subscriptions.

products.name: Commercial Management Software Tools
products.description: Software modules and tools for commercial operators, including league management, event scheduling, simulator administration, analytics, member messaging, and facility management, delivered as part of the E6 CONNECT ecosystem or standalone.

products.name: Custom Golf Simulator Installations
products.description: Bespoke design, consultation, and installation services for luxury residential, institutional, and commercial clients, including custom enclosures, flooring, audio/visual components, and multi-sport functionality. Delivered through project-based engagements.

products.name: Multi-Sport Arcade Add-Ons
products.description: Interactive entertainment add-ons for simulator systems, enabling arcade-style games and activities beyond golf, designed to increase appeal for families and groups in residential and commercial settings.

products.name: Technology-Enabled Driving Range Solutions
products.description: RANGE by TruGolf platform provides golf facilities with technology-enabled driving range solutions, including hardware and software for venues lacking traditional range infrastructure.

products.name: Franchise-Oriented Indoor Golf Venue Solutions
products.description: Development and provision of franchise-ready packages for indoor golf entertainment venues, including simulator bays, range bays, supporting technology, operating tools, and applications for booking and food-and-beverage ordering.

products.name: Virtual Golf Association (VGA) Digital Competition Platform
products.description: A digital competition and engagement framework built around the E6 software ecosystem, facilitating online golf events, leagues, and tournaments for users across multiple locations.

products.name: Infusion and Specialty Pharmacy Services
products.description: Provision of infused, injectable, and oral medication therapies for complex and chronic conditions (e.g., oncology, neurology, immunology) delivered in the home or clinic, requiring expert administration by pharmacists and nursing staff, supported by clinical coordination and patient support programs.

products.name: Home and Community Pharmacy Services
products.description: Daily medication therapy management and pharmacy dispensing services for complex patients in home and community settings, including senior living, group homes, hospice, and skilled nursing facilities, delivered via a localized, high-touch model with customized programs and rapid delivery from a network of pharmacies.

products.name: Home Health Care Services
products.description: Provision of skilled clinical care (e.g., nursing, therapy) to seniors and other patients in their homes, supporting recovery from illness or surgery and management of chronic diseases, delivered by clinical staff through in-person visits and care plans.

products.name: Hospice Services
products.description: Comprehensive end-of-life care for terminally ill patients, including physical, emotional, and spiritual support, delivered primarily in the home by interdisciplinary teams, with individualized care plans and daily pharmacy support.

products.name: Home-Based Primary Care Services
products.description: Primary care medical services delivered in patients’ homes, senior living communities, and group homes, focusing on proactive management of chronic and complex conditions, care coordination, and transitional care to reduce hospitalizations and improve outcomes.

products.name: Rehabilitation Therapy Services
products.description: Provision of specialized rehabilitation services, including physical, occupational, speech therapy, and applied behavior analysis (ABA), for patients of all ages with acute or chronic conditions, neurological injuries, or developmental disorders, primarily delivered in the home based on individualized care plans.

products.name: Personal Care Services
products.description: Supportive home care services assisting with activities of daily living (e.g., bathing, dressing, nutrition, social engagement) for seniors and individuals with functional limitations, delivered by caregivers in the home to promote independence and address social determinants of health.

products.name: Manufactured Homes
products.description: Factory-built, customizable residential homes constructed in the U.S. at company-owned manufacturing facilities, delivered through a network of independent and company-owned retail locations, and built to HUD or state codes. Homes range from 395 to 2,667 square feet and can be configured with various features and floor plans.

products.name: Tiny Houses
products.description: Small, recreational structures between 320 and 399 square feet, built in company factories, designed for temporary dwelling and mobility, and sold through retail channels. These are not required to meet HUD standards and are offered in various models and floor plans.

products.name: Financing Solutions for Manufactured Homes
products.description: Provision of inventory, consumer, and community-owner financing for manufactured homes and Tiny Houses, including chattel loans for consumers, inventory financing for retailers, and loans to community owners for property acquisition or development. Financing is offered directly by the company to facilitate home sales.

products.name: Cloud-Based SaaS Platform for Manufactured Home Retailers and Communities
products.description: A cloud-based software-as-a-service platform (FutureHomeX) acquired via AmeriCasa, designed to support manufactured home retailers and communities with digital tools for sales, leasing, and management.

products.name: Cloud Infrastructure Services (IaaS)
products.description: Provides virtual machines (Droplets), storage (object, block, backups), and networking (firewalls, load balancers, VPC, DNS, NAT gateways) through a global network of data centers. Delivered via a self-service digital platform, requiring significant physical infrastructure and technical management.

products.name: Managed Hosting
products.description: Offers fully managed hosting solutions for customers seeking to outsource infrastructure management, including onboarding, maintenance, and support for web hosting and eCommerce sites. Delivered as a managed service, primarily targeting customers without in-house technical resources.

products.name: Managed Databases
products.description: Provides fully managed database services for SQL (PostgreSQL, MySQL), NoSQL (MongoDB), caching (Valkey), streaming (Kafka), and search/analytics (OpenSearch). Delivered as a cloud service, removing operational burdens from customers.

products.name: Managed Kubernetes and Container Registry
products.description: Delivers a managed Kubernetes service and container registry, enabling customers to deploy, scale, and manage containerized applications in the cloud with minimal operational overhead. Delivered as a cloud-based managed service.

products.name: App Platform (Serverless PaaS)
products.description: A fully managed platform-as-a-service (PaaS) for building, deploying, and scaling applications, including serverless compute (Functions). Handles infrastructure, runtimes, and dependencies, allowing developers to focus on code. Delivered digitally via the cloud.

products.name: AI/ML Cloud Platform (Gradient AI)
products.description: Comprehensive AI/ML platform including GPU compute (GPU Droplets, Bare Metal GPUs), model hosting, agent development, and managed Jupyter Notebooks. Enables customers to build, test, and deploy AI agents and applications using cloud-based GPU infrastructure and AI tools.

products.name: Marketplace
products.description: A curated digital marketplace offering pre-configured applications, add-ons, and solutions optimized for deployment on DigitalOcean infrastructure. Enables customers to quickly deploy third-party and open-source software with minimal setup.

products.name: Uptime Monitoring
products.description: Provides real-time uptime and latency monitoring with alerts for customer assets, helping users quickly recover from incidents. Delivered as a digital SaaS tool integrated with the cloud platform.

products.name: Electric Utility Services
products.description: Provision of regulated electric utility services including generation, purchase, transmission, distribution, and sale of electric energy to residential, commercial, and industrial customers. Service is delivered via owned and jointly owned generation facilities and an extensive transmission and distribution network across a multi-state territory.

products.name: Metal Fabrication Services
products.description: Production of custom machine parts and metal components for OEM customers, including services such as research and development, tool design and construction, fabrication and welding, stamping, tubing, assembly, finishing, painting, and inventory management. Products are manufactured in large-scale facilities using advanced technologies and are distributed directly to customers.

products.name: Thermoformed Plastic Products
products.description: Manufacture of proprietary and custom thermoformed plastic products, including horticulture containers and custom packaging for medical, industrial, and other markets. Products are produced through vertically integrated processes involving pelletizing, extrusion, and thermoforming, and include items such as pots, trays, propagation sheets, and medical device packaging.

products.name: PVC Pipe Products
products.description: Manufacture and sale of polyvinyl chloride (PVC) pipe primarily used in municipal water infrastructure, including potable water distribution, wastewater collection, storm drainage, and water reclamation systems. Products are produced via extrusion processes in dedicated facilities and sold primarily through distributors to contractors, municipalities, and developers.

products.name: Cat Litter Products
products.description: Manufactured mineral-based and silica gel-based cat litter products, including scoopable, non-clumping, lightweight, antibacterial, and crystal litters, sold under company brands, private label, and co-packaged arrangements. Production involves surface mining, mineral processing, and packaging for retail and e-commerce distribution.

products.name: Industrial and Automotive Sorbent Products
products.description: Clay, polypropylene, and recycled material-based absorbent products for oil, acid, paint, ink, water, and other liquid spills, manufactured and processed for use in industrial, automotive, marine, and home applications. Delivered as granules, pads, rolls, socks, booms, and spill kits through distribution networks.

products.name: Sports Field Products
products.description: Manufactured mineral-based products for sports field maintenance, including soil conditioners, packing clay, and drying agents, used to improve drainage, suppress dust, and enhance field performance. Sold to sports field users and distributors for professional, collegiate, and municipal applications.

products.name: Fluids Purification and Bleaching Clays
products.description: Produced adsorbent and bleaching clay products for purification, bleaching, and filtration of edible oils, renewable diesel, jet fuel, and other petroleum-based products. Manufactured from mined minerals and processed for technical sales to processors and refiners globally.

products.name: Agricultural and Horticultural Carriers and Drying Agents
products.description: Manufactured mineral-based granules and powders serving as carriers for agricultural and horticultural chemicals, drying agents, and growing media. Products are engineered for precise application and improved flowability in lawn, garden, and row crop uses.

products.name: Animal Health and Nutrition Products
products.description: Produced and contract-manufactured mineral-based feed additives and health solutions for livestock, including toxin binders, pellet binders, and moisture managers, marketed under the Amlan brand and private labels. Sold directly and through distributors to livestock producers and feed mills globally.

products.name: SSi Mantra Surgical Robotic System
products.description: A next-generation, modular, multi-arm surgical robotic system designed, manufactured, and marketed for use in a wide range of minimally invasive surgeries across multiple specialties. Delivered as a physical capital equipment platform with advanced 3D vision, ergonomic surgeon console, and robotic arms, it is installed in hospitals and used by surgeons for robotically assisted procedures.

products.name: Surgical Instruments and Accessories (SSi Mudra)
products.description: A comprehensive suite of reusable, sterilizable endo-surgical instruments and accessory products (including stapling, energy, and core instrumentation, forceps, scissors, electrocautery tools, drapes, endoscopes, cannulas, and seals) designed and manufactured for use with the SSi Mantra system. Sold as consumables and replacement parts to hospitals and surgical centers.

products.name: Telesurgery and Tele-Proctoring Solutions
products.description: Remote surgery and mentoring capabilities enabled by the SSi Mantra system, including tele-proctoring and telesurgery platforms, mobile tele-surgical units (SSi MantraM), and compact tele-surgeon consoles (TSC). Delivered as integrated hardware and software solutions for remote operation and training, sold to hospitals and healthcare providers.

products.name: Digital Surgical Training and Simulation Platforms (SSi Maya)
products.description: Digital platforms and software tools for surgical training, education, and pre-operative planning, including mixed reality (XR) and AI-enabled simulators, virtual tele-mentoring (SSi Guru), cognitive skill simulators, holographic anatomy visualization, and advanced DICOM viewers. Delivered as software and hardware packages to hospitals and training centers.

products.name: Field Service, Maintenance, and Technical Support
products.description: Comprehensive after-sales services including installation, repair, maintenance, 24/7 technical support, proactive system health monitoring, software upgrades, and readiness support for SSi Mantra systems and instruments. Delivered by a network of field service engineers and support specialists to customer sites.

products.name: PBFT02 Gene Therapy
products.description: A one-time gene replacement therapy using an AAV1 viral vector to deliver a functional GRN gene encoding progranulin to the brain via intra cisterna magna administration, developed for the treatment of neurodegenerative diseases including FTD-GRN, FTD-C9orf72, ALS, and Alzheimer's disease. The therapy is manufactured using mammalian cell culture and advanced bioprocessing techniques, and is delivered through a regulated clinical process.

products.name: Huntington’s Disease Genetic Medicine (preclinical)
products.description: A preclinical gene therapy program aiming to treat Huntington’s disease by reducing somatic instability through AAV-mediated delivery of a miRNA gene to suppress MSH3 expression in the brain. This product is in preclinical development and involves advanced genetic engineering and delivery technologies.

products.name: Outlicensed Pediatric Gene Therapy Programs (GM1, Krabbe, MLD)
products.description: Previously developed pediatric gene therapy programs for GM1 gangliosidosis, Krabbe disease, and metachromatic leukodystrophy, now outlicensed to Gemma Biotherapeutics. These therapies use recombinant AAV vectors to deliver corrective genes and are manufactured using advanced bioprocessing methods.

products.name: Pilot and Astronaut Training
products.description: Provides supersonic jet-based training for pilots and astronauts using Lockheed F-104 aircraft, including type-specific and mission profile training in controlled airspace. Delivered through in-person flight operations and ground sessions, regulated by the FAA.

products.name: Launch Services for Small Payloads and Satellites
products.description: Offers air-launched rocket services using F-104 aircraft as a reusable first stage and proprietary StarLaunch rockets as second stage, enabling suborbital and orbital deployment of small payloads and satellites. Involves physical manufacturing, integration, and regulated launch operations.

products.name: Hypersonic R&D and Testbed Services
products.description: Provides airborne testbed services for hypersonic research and development, including flight testing of hypersonic technologies, components, and payloads at sustained MACH 2+ speeds using F-104 aircraft. Delivered through in-person flight operations and data collection for government and commercial clients.

products.name: Supersonic and High-Altitude In-Flight Testing Services
products.description: Conducts in-flight testing and qualification of aerospace hardware, payloads, and systems under supersonic and high-altitude conditions using F-104 aircraft. Includes captive carry, windstream, termination system, and suborbital simulation testing for commercial, academic, and defense clients.

products.name: Adversary Air and Jet Warbird Training
products.description: Provides adversary air training support and jet warbird familiarization flights for defense and commercial clients using F-104 aircraft. Delivered through in-person flight operations simulating combat or specialized flight scenarios.

products.name: Human Factors and Flight Physiology Testing
products.description: Offers testing services for human factors and flight physiology, utilizing supersonic flight environments to evaluate human performance and safety for aerospace applications. Delivered through in-person flight operations and data collection.

products.name: Avionics and Aerospace Hardware Testing
products.description: Provides in-flight testing and qualification of avionics and other aerospace hardware, including batteries, optics, and transmitters/receivers, under real-world supersonic and high-altitude conditions. Delivered via F-104 flight operations and data analysis.

products.name: Video Production and Aerial Photography Services
products.description: Offers video production and aerial photography services using F-104 aircraft for unique perspectives and high-speed flight footage. Delivered through in-person flight operations and media production.

products.name: Custom Chemical Manufacturing
products.description: Production of unique, proprietary specialty chemicals for strategic customers under long-term contracts, utilizing batch and continuous manufacturing processes at an integrated facility. Requires advanced technical expertise, regulatory compliance, and physical manufacturing infrastructure.

products.name: Performance Chemicals
products.description: Manufacture and sale of specialty chemicals such as polymer modifiers, specialty solvents, surfactants, and refined glycerin to multiple customers for industrial and consumer applications. Produced using advanced chemical synthesis and refining processes at scale.

products.name: Biofuels (Biodiesel and Blends)
products.description: Production and sale of biodiesel (fatty acid mono-alkyl esters) and biodiesel-petrodiesel blends using a continuous manufacturing process from various feedstocks. Delivered via truck, rail, and barge to transportation, agricultural, and heating markets. Subject to regulatory standards and incentives.

products.name: Renewable Identification Numbers (RINs)
products.description: Generation and sale of RIN credits, which are regulatory compliance instruments created during biodiesel production and sold either attached to fuel or as standalone credits. Managed through EPA systems and traded in compliance markets.

products.name: Glycerin Products (Crude and Refined)
products.description: Sale of crude and refined glycerin, a byproduct of biodiesel production, for industrial, agricultural, and specialty chemical applications. Refined on-site to meet high-purity requirements for premium markets.

products.name: Biodiesel Distillation Residue
products.description: Sale of distillation residue, a byproduct from biodiesel manufacturing, marketed as an additive for fuel oil and as a specialized asphalt release agent for industrial customers. Aggregated and distributed to various markets.

products.name: AI Data Center Infrastructure
products.description: Development and operation of large-scale, high-capacity data center campuses purpose-built for artificial intelligence workloads, leveraging access to substantial power infrastructure and renewable energy sources. Delivered through joint ventures and direct investment in physical facilities in Canada and the U.S.

products.name: Private Jet Charter Services
products.description: Provision of on-demand private jet charter flights to customers, utilizing both owned and partner-operated aircraft, facilitated through digital booking platforms and AI-powered tools. Service includes access to a variety of aircraft types and dynamic pricing.

products.name: Jet Card Memberships
products.description: Sale of prepaid jet card memberships that provide customers with a set number of private jet flight hours per year at fixed rates, with guaranteed aircraft availability and access to a managed fleet. Requires upfront payment and offers interchangeability across partner fleets.

products.name: Fractional Aircraft Ownership
products.description: Sale of fractional ownership interests in private jets, allowing customers to purchase a share of an aircraft and receive guaranteed usage hours, with management and operational services provided for a fixed term. Involves down payments, progress payments, and management fees.

products.name: Aircraft Management Services
products.description: Provision of aircraft management services for third-party aircraft owners, including flight crew, operations, maintenance, administration, and chartering of managed aircraft under limited management agreements. Delivered through partnerships with certified operators.

products.name: AI-Enhanced Charter Booking Platform (CharterGPT and Ava)
products.description: Digital platform and AI-powered tools (CharterGPT app and Ava AI model) for booking private jet charters, providing real-time availability, pricing, and personalized recommendations via web, mobile app, and SMS. Integrates with industry databases and automates booking workflows.

products.name: B2B SaaS Software for Aircraft Operators (Jet.AI Operator Platform)
products.description: Suite of web-based software-as-a-service products for aircraft operators, including Reroute AI (empty leg optimization) and DynoFlight (emissions tracking and carbon offset purchasing), delivered via APIs and web interfaces to streamline operations and compliance.

products.name: By-the-Seat Private Jet Booking Services
products.description: Offering of private jet travel on a by-the-seat basis through a joint venture, allowing customers to purchase individual seats on charter flights, facilitated by a dedicated booking tool for specific clients and partners.
